tool_schemas.name: start_scan
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new scan job for the provided target URL and optional scan_type (passive, active, or full) and returns the created scan record including its scan_id and initial status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when target is missing, not a valid URL, or scan_type is not one of the allowed values; raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to start scans; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when you have reached your allowed scan concurrency or job limit; raises CONFLICT if a scan for the same target is already running and duplicates are not allowed.

tool_schemas.name: get_scan_status
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current state of the scan identified by scan_id, including progress/status fields available for that job. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when scan_id is missing or malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have access to this scan; raises NOT_FOUND when no scan exists with the given scan_id.

scan_id.description: ID of the scan to check

tool_schemas.name: get_scan_issues
tool_schemas.description: Lists the vulnerability issues produced by the specified scan, optionally filtered by severity (high, medium, low, info, or all), and returns the matching issue records. Results are capped by the service default limit and are not pageable via cursor/offset parameters for this endpoint. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when scan_id is missing/malformed or severity is not one of the allowed values; raises UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have access to this scan; raises NOT_FOUND when the scan_id does not exist.

tool_schemas.name: get_proxy_history
tool_schemas.description: Returns captured HTTP/HTTPS proxy traffic entries, optionally filtered by host, method, and status_code, limited to the most recent items up to limit (default 10); this endpoint uses limit-only truncation and does not support paging tokens/offsets. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when limit or status_code is not a valid number or when method is not a valid HTTP token; raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to view proxy history.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default: 10)

tool_schemas.name: get_site_map
tool_schemas.description: Returns discovered site map entries, optionally filtered by host and with_parameters, limited to the most recent items up to limit (default 20); this endpoint uses limit-only truncation and does not support paging tokens/offsets. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when limit is not a valid number or with_parameters is not a boolean; raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to view the site map.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default: 20)

tool_schemas.name: list_scans
tool_schemas.description: Lists scan jobs visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status, target_url/host, and created time. Returns scan records ordered by created_at descending. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters or pagination parameters; raises UNAUTHORIZED when you are not permitted to list scans.

status.description: Filter by scan status; use 'all' to include every status (default: all).

target_url.description: Filter scans by exact target URL (optional).

created_after.description: Only include scans created after this timestamp (RFC3339, optional).

created_before.description: Only include scans created before this timestamp (RFC3339, optional).

limit.description: Maximum number of scans to return (default: 50; clamped to 1..200).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response (optional).

tool_schemas.name: update_scan
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields of a scan job, including driving allowed status transitions (queued→running/cancelled/failed, running→completed/failed/cancelled). Returns the updated scan record. Refuses invalid transitions, setting completed_at/progress_pct rules, or updates to immutable fields. Raises NOT_FOUND if scan_id does not exist; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid updates; raises UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have access to this scan.

scan_id.description: ID of the scan to update.

status.description: New scan status. Must follow the allowed transition map; setting to completed/failed/cancelled sets completed_at (and progress_pct to 100 for completed).

progress_pct.description: Progress percentage (0..100). Ignored/refused when status is completed; must be <=100 for failed/cancelled.

error_message.description: Optional failure/cancellation message; typically used when status is failed or cancelled.

tool_schemas.name: get_scan_issue
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single issue record by issue_id. Returns the issue if it exists and is visible to the caller. Raises NOT_FOUND when no issue exists with the given issue_id; raises UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have access to the issue.

issue_id.description: ID of the issue to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: update_scan_issue
tool_schemas.description: Updates a scan issue record. Primarily used to reclassify severity according to the allowed transitions (info↔low↔medium↔high, with constraints). Returns the updated issue. Refuses changes that would break FK integrity or violate lifecycle transitions. Raises NOT_FOUND if issue_id does not exist; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid updates; raises UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have access to the issue.

issue_id.description: ID of the issue to update.

severity.description: New severity. Must follow the declared severity transition map.

confidence.description: Optional confidence label provided by the scanner (e.g., certain, firm, tentative).

tool_schemas.name: get_proxy_history_entry
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single proxy history entry by id, including request/response headers and bodies when retained. Returns the entry record. Raises NOT_FOUND if the entry does not exist or was purged by retention; raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not permitted to view proxy history.

id.description: ID of the proxy history entry to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_user
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated calling identity, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Refuses when authentication is missing or invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when credentials are not provided or are rejected.

include_quota.description: When true, include detailed quota and rate-limit counters (default: true).

include_scopes.description: When true, include the granted scopes/permissions list (default: true).

metadata.name: Burpsuite Server
metadata.description: This backend stores BurpSuite-driven scanning activity and the artifacts produced during security testing: scan jobs, detected issues, captured proxy traffic, and the discovered site map. The main workflows are: create a scan against a target URL, poll its status, retrieve issues filtered by severit
